stories.exam_facts: 1,173 constables used fake permanent addresses for district quota jobs; probe initiated by Inspector General of Police Md Ali Hossain Fakir on 15 March; covered 76,448 constables recruited 2014-2024; 980 (over 83 percent) recruited in Dhaka (643 in 2015, 303 in 2014); Narayanganj second with 93; more than 100 ineligible constables got jobs allegedly through political interference; around 200 got unusually high viva marks despite poor written results.

sources.headline: 1,173 constables used fake addresses to get jobs in quota

stories.summary: At least 1,173 police constables, mostly recruited in Dhaka during the Awami League government's tenure, used fake permanent addresses to secure jobs under district-based recruitment quotas, a police investigation found. The probe covered 76,448 constables recruited between 2014 and 2024; 980 of the 1,173 were recruited in Dhaka, with 643 in 2015 and 303 in 2014. Police Headquarters is verifying the findings before sending a report to the home ministry recommending action.
